text:
Maria - CS: FYI — XXCorp saw a repeat of the latency/503 spike this morning during their batch imports. Opening thread to capture action items and owners.
Aj Patel: thanks Maria. Is this the same pattern as last week (KV cache cold-start + routing fallback)?
Maria - CS: looks similar in the dashboard. Increased tail latency at ~08:12 UTC, then several 503s for ~3 minutes. Usage was slightly above their normal ingest rate.
Devon (Oncall): I pulled logs — we have a storm of queued requests and a couple of worker OOMs. Snapshot here: https://dash.redwood/xxcorp/incidents/1765432100
Sasha (Infra): can you paste the error traces? If it's OOM we might be hitting a quantized model memory edge on that Dedicated pool.
Devon (Oncall): paste logs:
```
ERR worker-22: allocate_gpu_buffer failed: out_of_memory
WARN request-queue: reject request id=abc123 status=503
```
Tim - Support: Customer reported time window and attached SDK logs. They retried and ~60% succeeded after ~2 mins.
Maria - CS: Customer impact: ingestion backoff + retries caused duplicate rows; they asked for mitigation and a root cause plan. Renewal conversation next month so this is priority.
Aj Patel: proposed action items: 1) short term — add a circuit-breaker/queue cap for that route; 2) mid term — increase reserved GPU headroom for the Dedicated pool for XXCorp; 3) follow-up — run a replay test with their ingest pattern. Owners?
Sasha (Infra): I can own short-term queue cap change (safe toggle). ETA EOD UTC. Will add feature flag and a 5m rolling reject threshold.
Devon (Oncall): I'll roll a hotfix restart for the affected node group, monitor memory and tail latency. ETA 30m.
Tim - Support: I'll coordinate with customer on a safe retry/backoff patch they can apply client-side and send them a mitigation checklist.
Maria - CS: I'll update the account exec and include this in the renewal risk doc. Also scheduling a postmortem with the customer.
Aj Patel: For mid-term capacity increase, Sasha do we need a purchase/commit or can we reallocate existing Dedicated headroom?
Sasha (Infra): We have ~12% free capacity in the pool but not contiguous GPUs for the model shape. I'll run a capacity projection; if we need reserved nodes we'll need finance signoff. Target next-week planning sync.
Devon (Oncall): Monitoring hooks added: extra tracing on worker allocation, and an alert NB: 5xx-rate > 1% for 5m now auto-notify #eng-oncall. infra-bot: Alert rule created (rule id: r-4421) by Sasha (Infra).
Maria - CS: Action item checklist then:
- Sasha: queue cap rollout (owner), EOD UTC, add alert rule (done)
- Devon: hotfix restart + monitor, in 30m
- Tim: customer mitigation checklist + confirm client retry change, today
- Sasha/Aj: capacity projection + finance ask, next-week planning
- Maria: renewal risk update + postmortem scheduling, by Friday
Devon (Oncall): I'll post a short incident summary (2–3 bullets) when the hotfix is complete.
Tim - Support: Customer already appreciative of the quick follow-up; asked for an interim SLA note. I'll send a templated note and loop Maria.
Maria - CS: thanks all. Please update the ticket #INC-2209 with each deliverable so we have a single source for the postmortem.
Sasha (Infra): noted, will add a short runbook entry for this route so it's easier next time.
Devon (Oncall): hotfix applied — memory stable. Monitoring shows tail latency back to baseline. Will keep an eye for 1 hour.
Maria - CS: great — closing loop with customer now. I'll post the PM notes and link to replay plan in this thread by EOD. :thumbsup:
Tim - Support: Sent interim SLA note to customer, cc Maria. They said "appreciate the quick response".
Maria - CS: leaving this here for the weekly account health check. If anything regresses, re-open thread. Thanks everyone.
